title: Automatic Cut & Arrange – Adidas 3 Stripes
description:
Project Overview



Development of an automatic cutting and panel arranging attachment for the Adidas 3 Stripes sewing process using a Kansai multi-needle sewing machine.



Previous Process



During sewing, operators continuously joined the 3-stripe material in a long sequence. Once a sufficient quantity had been sewn, the continuous material had to be cut manually into individual panels.



This resulted in two separate operations:

1. Continuous sewing of the 3-stripe material.

2. Manual cutting and separation of individual panels.



Automation Solution



Developed an automatic attachment integrated with the Kansai multi-needle sewing machine to automate the cutting and arranging of individual panels.



The solution combined the sewing output process with automatic cutting and panel arrangement, eliminating the need for the separate repetitive manual cutting operation.



My Contribution



Involved in automation development and production process improvement, focusing on the integration of the automatic attachment with the existing sewing machine.



Implementation



A total of 4 units were developed and implemented.
technologies: Industrial Automation, Kansai Multi-Needle Sewing Machine, Machine Attachment Development, Automatic Cutting, Panel Handling
